entities.summary: Sipe Santapukki (b. 1977-12-20, Lahti) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Lahti and Finland. Known in the fields of finland, composers & musicians, europe.
